name: breadcrumb
purpose: Shows the page hierarchy so users can navigate back to parent views. Composes `BreadcrumbList`, `BreadcrumbItem`, and `BreadcrumbSeparator` (chevron). Accepts an `items` array for the common case or slot composition for custom layouts. Reference: PrimeNG Breadcrumb (adapted to Webkit tokens).
useWhen: A page sits two or more levels deep and the reader needs a way back to its parents (resource detail under a list, a settings sub-page).
The trail is known as data — pass `items` and let the component render the segments, separators and the collapse below `md`.
The trail needs a custom layout the `items` array cannot express — compose `Breadcrumb.List`, `Breadcrumb.Item` and `Breadcrumb.Separator` in the default slot.
avoidWhen: It is the app's primary navigation → use `navigation-menu` or `sidebar` with `menu`.
It moves between sibling views of the same page → use `tabs`.
It is the previous / next pair at the end of a docs page → use `doc-pagination`.
related: breadcrumb-item` — the single segment this component renders; use it alone only inside a hand-composed trail.
navigation-menu` — top-level navigation with dropdown panels, not a location trail.
link` — a standalone link; a breadcrumb segment is a link with the trail's muted / current styling.
bestPractices: Prefer `items`; only `items` mode collapses the middle segments into an overflow menu below `md`. The default slot renders only when `items` is empty, and a hand-composed trail never collapses.
Let the last entry be the current page — it is treated as current unless its `current` is set to `false`; give every ancestor an `href`.
Handle routing in `@navigate`, which receives `(event, href)` for ancestor segments; call `event.preventDefault()` when a client-side router takes over.
In slot mode, wrap each `Breadcrumb.Item` in an `li`: `Breadcrumb.List` is an `ol` and the item renders an `a` / `span`, while `Breadcrumb.Separator` is already an `li`.

props.name: items
props.doc: Ordered path segments; the last entry is treated as the current page when `current` is omitted on that entry.

events.name: navigate
events.notes: Fires when an ancestor segment is activated. `event` is the activation event; `href` is the segment's destination.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: Custom composition (`BreadcrumbList` + items + separators). Used when `items` is empty.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Breadcrumb from '@aziontech/webkit/breadcrumb'

  const items = [
    { label: 'Page Name', href: '#' },
    { label: 'Page Name', href: '#' },
    { label: 'Page Name', href: '#' },
    { label: 'Page Name', href: '#' },
    { label: 'Current Page', current: true }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <Breadcrumb
    :items="items"
    class="max-w-[42.5rem]"
  />
</template>
